$comment: D16 agent trials for the M3 exit criterion (SRS §11): with forge-test-mcp an agent needs fewer turns or tokens than with raw `forge test -vvvv`. Same prompt in both arms except the one sentence naming the tools. Fixtures are test/fixtures/projects/*; success is decided by trials/score.js with real forge, never by the agent. Run records follow the schema agreed with the Evaluator for eval/results/<date>/trials/.

tasks.prompt: The tests in this Foundry project fail. Find out why and fix the contract in src/ so that every test passes. Do not change, skip or delete any test, and do not change foundry.toml.

A fuzz test in this Foundry project fails. Find out why and fix the code in src/ so that every test passes for all inputs. Do not change, skip or delete any test, do not bound the fuzz inputs, and do not change foundry.toml.
An invariant test in this Foundry project fails. Find out why and fix the contract in src/ so that every test passes. Do not change, skip or delete any test, and do not change foundry.toml.
This Foundry project does not compile. Fix the source in src/ so that it compiles and every test passes. Do not change, skip or delete any test, and do not change foundry.toml.

A-tool.toolSentence: Use the forge-test MCP tools (run_tests, explain_failure, build) to build and test.

B-shell.toolSentence: Use `forge build` and `forge test -vvvv` in the shell to build and test.
